facts.text: I am writing a fantasy fiction piece titled "The Lost City".
I want prompts or exercises to develop my world-building and characters for "The Lost City".
I like the idea of creating a detailed map of the Lost City.
I have used Ulysses to organize my writing projects.
I have never thought of using Ulysses to create a map of my Lost City.
I want to use Ulysses to create a mind map or outline of my Lost City.
I plan to use Method 1 in Ulysses with headers and subheaders to organize my city into different districts and areas.
I want to use Ulysses to keep track of my characters and their relationships with each other.
I plan to create a new sheet in Ulysses for my main character, the protagonist of "The Lost City".
I plan to organize my protagonist's bio, appearance, skills, relationships, and quests using headers and subheaders in Ulysses.
I plan to create a separate sheet in Ulysses for my antagonist and other key characters.
I plan to use Ulysses' linking feature to connect characters and track their relationships.
I plan to experiment with character development techniques like character interviews and journaling.
I plan to create a separate sheet in Ulysses for my personal essay about my trip to Japan.
I have been wanting to write about my trip to Japan for ages.
I think using Ulysses will help me structure my essay and get my thoughts down on paper.

events.text: Planning to write a personal essay about a trip to Japan using Ulysses
